title: fix outcome
description: The outcome of a fix round (feature-workon-review.md, workon-review.md). bl records in_review by fix in the unit's transition log when fixed is true (F-68 D3, F-69 D5); the loop escalates when it is false.

summary.description: One line: what the fix round did.

fixed.description: true when every Must fix and Should fix item of the latest session is checked off.

open.description: The Must fix and Should fix items of the latest session still unchecked. open is 0 exactly when fixed is true.
